phases.objective: Establish an explicit fourth database identity for Production Recovery durable control state that cannot silently reuse runtime, governance, or runtime-persistence target databases or principals.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Resolve Recovery control-store database configuration before constructing any durable Recovery authority adapter.
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: A dedicated RECOVERY_CONTROL_DB_* configuration resolves only when its database and principal are distinct from every target role; missing or reused target identities fail closed before a database connection is created.
steps: Require explicit Recovery control database name, user and password without falling back to runtime, governance or runtime-persistence database identities.
Allow a shared physical MySQL host only when the logical database and principal remain independent.
Reject database-name collision with runtime, governance or runtime-persistence targets.
Reject principal collision with runtime, governance or runtime-persistence identities.
Bound pool size and connection timeout before any future live adapter may consume the control-store pool.

Classify the synthetic isolation check through the canonical http-generic-api/scripts/e2e-*.mjs repository-governance path while preserving recoveryControlDb.js as shared runtime, so the exact source change declares both Staging and Production impact without expanding test authority.
Require fresh live Staging certification for this shared-runtime source change before merge eligibility.
Keep this source phase disconnected from the Recovery Kernel and from Production deployment until the remaining #7999 authority adapters, schema and activation evidence are separately reviewed.
assertions: RECOVERY_CONTROL_DB_NAME never falls back to DB_NAME, GOVERNANCE_DB_NAME or RUNTIME_PERSISTENCE_DB_NAME.
RECOVERY_CONTROL_DB_USER never falls back to DB_USER, GOVERNANCE_DB_USER or RUNTIME_PERSISTENCE_DB_USER.
RECOVERY_CONTROL_DB_PASSWORD never falls back to any target-role password.
The resolved control database and principal are distinct from all three target roles.
Configuration errors expose no credential values and report secrets_included=false.
The synthetic check remains repository governance and does not create or modify a registered test authority invariant.
The shared-runtime source impact declares both staging and production and requires live Staging certification.
No database connection, SQL execution, Production deployment, grant, migration, provider mutation or activation is performed by this source phase.

phases.objective: Implement the independent durable Recovery Store schema and atomic reservation/fencing adapters on top of the dedicated control-store boundary without applying schema or connecting to a live database in this source phase.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Construct the Production Recovery durable store and fenced-lock adapters from the dedicated Recovery control-store pool boundary.
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The repository exposes the complete canonical Recovery Store method surface, an explicit non-auto-applied InnoDB schema plan, single-use approval/execution reservations, immutable ticket identity, atomic execution claims, and a durable monotonic fencing counter while remaining disconnected from live databases and Production activation.
steps: Define dedicated InnoDB control-store tables for Recovery objects, idempotency receipts, approval indexes, claims/reservations/finalizations, execution tickets, append-only evidence and fenced locks.
Preserve the canonical mad4b.recovery-durable-store.v1 contract and every Recovery composition store method required by recoveryComposition.js.
Persist run idempotency independently and reject idempotency-key rebinding to another Recovery run.
Make execution claims and approval reservations single-winner through unique primary keys and transactional readback.
Keep execution-ticket identity immutable and require a matching reservation idempotency key before release or finalization.
Implement Recovery locks with SELECT FOR UPDATE transactions and a durable monotonic fence_counter that survives release and increments on every new lease or expired-lease takeover.
Keep schema application explicit and external: importing or constructing the adapter does not open the pool and schema_auto_apply remains false.
Defer real concurrent writers, restart durability and ambiguous-outcome certification to the resilient phase against a disposable non-Production control store.
assertions: The adapter reports recovery_store_contract=mad4b.recovery-durable-store.v1, independent_of_target_databases=true and target_database_binding=forbidden.
Every store method required by Recovery composition is present, including atomic claims, approval reservations and execution-ticket reservation/finalization methods.
The fenced lock exposes acquire, heartbeat, assertFence and release and keeps a persistent monotonic fence counter instead of deleting lock generations.
The schema plan is CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS only, auto_apply=false, and contains no DROP or TRUNCATE statement.
Constructing the store, lock and schema plan performs zero database connections and zero database mutations.
No Production deployment, SQL execution, GRANT, migration Apply, provider mutation, Recovery live activation, secret provisioning or execution-ticket issuance is performed by this source phase.

phases.objective: Prove replay prevention, concurrent reservations, fencing, restart durability, ambiguous outcomes and no-secret receipts against a disposable non-Production control store.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Run the exact pull-request candidate against an ephemeral MariaDB 11.4 service using two independent connection pools and CI-only credentials.
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Concurrent approval/ticket reservations have one durable winner, finalized tickets reject replay after pool recreation, fenced-lock takeover increments the generation and invalidates the stale fence, durable runs/receipts survive new connections, ambiguous claim retry resolves the existing claim, and bounded evidence remains secret-free without touching Production.
steps: Start disposable MariaDB 11.4 inside GitHub Actions with fixed CI-only credentials and no repository secrets.
Apply only the existing Recovery control-store CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS schema to the disposable database.
Create two independent pools and race approval and execution-ticket reservations against shared durable state.
Finalize the winning execution ticket and prove it cannot be reserved again.
Acquire a short fenced lease, prove a competing lease is busy, then take over only after expiry with a strictly higher durable fence generation.
Destroy the original pools, create a new pool, and prove run/idempotency, receipt and finalized-ticket state remain durable.
Discard the first execution-claim response deliberately, retry through another replica, and resolve the existing durable claim without duplication.
Replay identical append-only evidence and prove the second append is rejected by the durable event hash.
Publish only bounded booleans and contract metadata; do not publish connection credentials, ticket material, approval material or fencing tokens.
assertions: Exactly one approval reservation wins under concurrent replicas.
Exactly one execution-ticket reservation wins under concurrent replicas.
A finalized ticket remains non-replayable after connection-pool recreation.
Expired lock takeover increments the durable fence counter and invalidates the previous fence.
Run/idempotency and receipt evidence survive recreation of all original pools.
Retry after a deliberately discarded claim response resolves the existing claim instead of creating a second claim.
Identical append-only evidence is replay-safe.
The certification uses only disposable CI MariaDB and reports production_authorized=false, live_activation_performed=false and secrets_included=false.
Disposable MariaDB readback verifies every Control Store table and rejects a missing locks table or malformed fencing counter before recovery execution.

phases.objective: Bind the complete concrete adapter graph to fresh signed Staging certification and exact Production deployment evidence without enabling Production mutation.

Keep Production live activation blocked until #7999 has a provisioned independent control store, complete typed adapter graph, fresh signed readiness, exact Production activation readiness and separate explicit activation authorization.
